questions.text: Fashion Factory OG wants to grant Prokura to Carmen Schwaiger. May the company do so, and may Carmen Schwaiger advertise a part-time position afterward?
options: No, because an OG is not entered in the Commercial Register
Yes, an OG is in the Commercial Register and may grant Prokura; hiring staff is permitted for Prokurists
Yes to Prokura, but hiring employees is reserved strictly for company owners
No, because only a GmbH or AG may recruit staff through Prokurists
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, an OG is in the Commercial Register and may grant Prokura; hiring staff is permitted for Prokurists

questions.text: Sabine Mitterlehner holds Sole Prokura at Kaboom Elektrotechnik GmbH with an internal loan cap of EUR 10,000.00. She still takes out a EUR 15,000.00 bank loan. What applies legally?
options: The loan contract is completely void both externally and internally
The bank must absorb the EUR 5,000.00 difference itself
Externally the loan is valid toward the bank; internally she breached instructions and risks damages or dismissal
The loan automatically converts into a Commercial Power of Attorney
questions.correctAnswer: Externally the loan is valid toward the bank; internally she breached instructions and risks damages or dismissal

questions.text: Lena Truppe is to manage the new Mixologie Cocktailbar in Ischgl without signing authority for other locations. Which type of Prokura fits best (assuming Commercial Register entry)?
options: Branch Prokura
Sole Prokura for the entire group
Category Power of Attorney
Special Power of Attorney
questions.correctAnswer: Branch Prokura

questions.text: A holder of Prokura is legally permitted to sign the company's annual balance sheet and sell company real estate.
questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.text: Biona Ibrahimi is authorized at C&A to order merchandise up to EUR 40,000.00, but not to conduct other branch transactions. Which authority and signature prefix apply?
options: General Power of Attorney with i. V.
Branch Prokura with ppa.
Special Power of Attorney with pp.
Category Power of Attorney with i. A.
questions.correctAnswer: Category Power of Attorney with i. A.

questions.text: Fadil Berisha holds a General Power of Attorney at MediaMarkt. May he purchase EUR 50,000.00 worth of electronics if the supplier knows of no internal limit?
options: Yes, because purchasing electronics is an ordinary transaction for MediaMarkt
No, because purchases above EUR 10,000.00 always require Prokura
No, because a General Power of Attorney only covers paying wages
Yes, but only after publishing the purchase order via EVI
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, because purchasing electronics is an ordinary transaction for MediaMarkt

questions.text: An employee of a tire retailer holds a Commercial Power of Attorney. Which transaction is legally NOT permitted under this authority?
options: Ordering winter tires from a wholesaler
Paying monthly salaries to workshop staff
Taking out a bank loan or buying car batteries outside the tire business
Selling summer tires to retail customers
questions.correctAnswer: Taking out a bank loan or buying car batteries outside the tire business

questions.text: Explain the difference between Prokura and a Commercial Power of Attorney regarding Commercial Register entry, form of grant, loans and court representation, external effect of internal caps, and signature prefix.
questions.correctAnswer: Prokura: mandatory Commercial Register entry plus EVI publication; express declaration only; allows bank loans and court representation; internal limits have no effect against third parties; signed with pp. or ppa. Commercial Power of Attorney: not entered in the Commercial Register; express declaration or implied conduct; loans and court representation are forbidden; internal limits bind third parties if they know or ought to know; signed with i. V. (General Power of Attorney) or i. A. (Category/Special Power of Attorney).

questions.text: Sascha Seidel works as a full-time engineer at AT&S in Leoben with fixed hours, company equipment, and employer instructions. Which combination of contract, insurance, and tax applies?
options: Contract for Work, SVS self-registration, and income tax return
Regular Employment Contract, OeGK registration, and wage tax deducted by the employer
Freelance Service Contract, OeGK registration, and income tax return
Marginal Employment, accident insurance only, and no wage tax
questions.correctAnswer: Regular Employment Contract, OeGK registration, and wage tax deducted by the employer

questions.text: Which statement about marginal employment (such as Saturday retail work below the marginal earnings threshold) is correct?
options: There is no entitlement to paid vacation and no sick pay
The employee pays full wage tax plus health and pension insurance
The employer provides health, pension, and unemployment insurance
The worker gets paid vacation, sick pay, and special payments, while the employer covers only accident insurance
questions.correctAnswer: The worker gets paid vacation, sick pay, and special payments, while the employer covers only accident insurance

questions.text: Which mandatory internship rule applies to HAK students in Austria?
options: 300 hours in lesson-free time between Year II and before entering Year V
120 hours exclusively during summer break after Year IV
500 hours under a mandatory Contract for Work
60 hours during regular school weeks in Year I
questions.correctAnswer: 300 hours in lesson-free time between Year II and before entering Year V

questions.text: A holiday job always constitutes a Regular Employment Contract with full entitlement to paid vacation, sick pay, and special payments.
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.text: At Kronen Zeitung, Sharif Salah is a staff journalist, Lisa Wenig submits three articles per week with flexible hours, and Pascal Geiger creates one illustration. Which contract mapping is correct?
options: Sharif: Freelance Service Contract; Lisa: Contract for Work; Pascal: Regular Employment Contract
Sharif: Regular Employment Contract; Lisa: Contract for Work; Pascal: Freelance Service Contract
Sharif: Regular Employment Contract; Lisa: Freelance Service Contract; Pascal: Contract for Work
Sharif: Contract for Work; Lisa: Regular Employment Contract; Pascal: Freelance Service Contract
questions.correctAnswer: Sharif: Regular Employment Contract; Lisa: Freelance Service Contract; Pascal: Contract for Work

questions.text: Tobias Krain works continuously from home using a publisher's laptop with free hours and no instructions. How are his social insurance and income tax handled?
options: SVS self-registration and wage tax deducted by the publisher
OeGK registration by the publisher and self-taxation via income tax return
Accident insurance only and no income tax
OeGK registration by the publisher and wage tax deducted by the publisher
questions.correctAnswer: OeGK registration by the publisher and self-taxation via income tax return

questions.text: Christoph Wurm repairs a company laptop using his own tools for a fixed fee payable upon successful repair. Which obligation applies if the repair is defective?
options: No liability, because the client carries the full economic risk
Only a duty to notify the OeGK within 14 days
Entitlement to paid sick leave during re-repair
Warranty liability for defects under his Contract for Work
questions.correctAnswer: Warranty liability for defects under his Contract for Work

questions.text: Assign the right contract type to these two AT&S cases and justify briefly using equipment, risk, social insurance, and vacation rights: (a) Helena Kickert creates a finished building sketch for a fee; (b) Eva Brandstatter prepares ongoing data reports with free time and place using company equipment.
questions.correctAnswer: (a) Helena Kickert: Contract for Work (concrete finished result, own work equipment, own economic risk and warranty liability, registers independently with SVS, self-taxed, no paid vacation or sick pay). (b) Eva Brandstatter: Freelance Service Contract (ongoing labor without personal dependency, employer's equipment, no economic risk, registered at OeGK by employer, self-taxed, no paid vacation or sick pay).

questions.text: Which group contains exclusively Austria's four most important export trading partners?
options: Germany, the USA, Italy, and Switzerland
Germany, France, China, and Spain
Switzerland, Poland, Brazil, and Qatar
Italy, Hungary, Japan, and the USA
questions.correctAnswer: Germany, the USA, Italy, and Switzerland

questions.text: Which causes of foreign trade are illustrated by the examples of cheese from Holland and ski production in Austria?
options: Both examples show unavailable domestic natural resources
Cheese from Holland shows brand image; ski production shows price dumping
Cheese from Holland shows a domestic production surplus; ski production in Austria shows country specialization
Both examples show government export bans

questions.text: Which advantage does globalisation typically bring to Austrian companies?
options: Elimination of all international competition and higher tariff protection
Larger markets and sales, economies of scale, cheaper inputs, and know-how transfer
Guaranteed immunity from exchange rate and supply-chain risks
No need for market research when entering unfamiliar cultures

questions.text: According to WKO (2025), more than 63,000 Austrian companies export goods and services worth EUR 203 billion (2024) to over 200 countries.
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.text: BWT AG concludes a USD 250,000.00 Letter of Credit worth EUR 245,000.00 at signing. At payout, due to a weaker USD, BWT receives only EUR 233,000.00. Which risk materialized and how large was the loss?
options: Transport risk with a EUR 17,000.00 damage loss
Transfer risk with a EUR 250,000.00 freeze
Production risk with EUR 5,000.00 extra cost
Exchange rate risk with a EUR 12,000.00 currency loss

questions.text: Lenz Moser ships 7,000 bottles of wine to Taiwan invoiced in USD with a 3-month payment term. Which risk arises specifically from the long payment term, and how can it be managed?
options: Credit/refinancing risk; managed via subsidized export financing (Exportfonds/OeKB), factoring, or forfaiting

Warranty risk; managed through a price fluctuation clause

questions.text: How can an importer protect itself against warranty risk if the exporter fails to fix defects in delivered equipment after delivery?
options: By paying the entire purchase price in advance
By taking out export financing at its own house bank
By obtaining a bank guarantee from the exporter's bank
By avoiding written sales contracts

questions.text: Political risk (such as war, strikes, or riots in the importing country) can be completely eliminated through standard market research.
questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.text: Andritz (Graz) ships machinery via Trieste to Asmidal (Algiers) under CIF Port Algier. Who pays sea freight and insurance, and who files an insurance claim for ocean damage?

Andritz pays sea freight and insurance; Asmidal files the claim because risk passed on board in Trieste
Andritz pays sea freight and insurance and also bears full ocean risk until Algiers
Asmidal pays only insurance; the port of Trieste bears the ocean risk

questions.text: Honigmayr (Salzburg) ships honey to Novotel Berlin under CPT Munich Freight Station. During the rail journey, 10% of the jars break. Who handles the damage claim?
options: Honigmayr, because Munich is the named place of cost transfer
Honigmayr, because CPT is a Group D arrival rule
The Salzburg tax office through the state export guarantee
Novotel Berlin, because risk passed upon handover to the rail carrier in Salzburg

questions.text: Which Incoterms 2020 rule obligates the seller to clear both export and import customs and deliver the goods ready for unloading at the named destination?
options: DDP (Delivered Duty Paid)
DPU (Delivered at Place Unloaded)
DAP (Delivered at Place)
FCA (Free Carrier)

questions.text: Biofit (Wiener Neustadt) quotes sneakers for Happy Living (USA): EXW EUR 80.00, road to Salzburg EUR 2.50, road Salzburg-Amsterdam EUR 10.00, loading Amsterdam EUR 5.00, insurance WN-Salzburg EUR 0.50, sea freight EUR 20.00, marine insurance EUR 8.00, landing NY EUR 5.00, duties EUR 12.00. questions.text: Good4U Cosmetics (Dusseldorf) quotes Top Beauty (Lisbon): EXW EUR 10,000, road to Rotterdam EUR 300, loading Rotterdam EUR 200, sea transport EUR 1,500, sea insurance EUR 100, landing Lisbon EUR 170, road to Top Beauty EUR 80. What are the FAS Rotterdam and CIF Lisbon prices?
options: FAS Rotterdam: EUR 10,500; CIF Lisbon: EUR 12,270
FAS Rotterdam: EUR 10,300; CIF Lisbon: EUR 12,100
FAS Rotterdam: EUR 10,300; CIF Lisbon: EUR 12,000
FAS Rotterdam: EUR 10,000; CIF Lisbon: EUR 12,350

questions.text: In the Good4U Cosmetics case (Dusseldorf to Lisbon), under DAP Lisbon port the exporter also pays the Lisbon landing charges (EUR 170) and onward truck delivery to Top Beauty (EUR 80).
questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.text: For PureFruit GmbH (Vienna to Barcelona, intra-EU), calculate the selling prices for FOB Hamburg, CIF Barcelona, and DDP Barcelona from EXW EUR 4,500, road Vienna-Hamburg EUR 480, loading Hamburg EUR 120, sea freight EUR 650, marine insurance EUR 70, landing Barcelona EUR 100, and road to Delicia Market EUR 80, and state the risk transfer point for each.
questions.correctAnswer: FOB Hamburg: 4,500 + 480 + 120 = EUR 5,100 (risk transfers on board in Hamburg). CIF Barcelona: 5,100 + 650 + 70 = EUR 5,820 (risk transfers on board in Hamburg as a two-point rule; excludes landing). DDP Barcelona: 5,820 + 100 + 80 = EUR 6,000 with EUR 0 intra-EU duties (risk transfers at Delicia Market in Barcelona, ready for unloading).

questions.text: Which transport document applies to air freight, and which applies to international rail transport?
options: Air freight: CMR; rail: Bill of Lading (B/L)

Air freight: Ocean Bill of Lading; rail: CMR

questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.text: Explain the difference between D/P and D/A in a Documentary Collection and name three conditions under which a Documentary Collection is recommended.
questions.correctAnswer: Under D/P (Documents against Payment), the importer receives the shipping documents simultaneously against immediate payment. Under D/A (Documents against Acceptance), the exporter grants a payment term and the importer receives the documents upon accepting a bill of exchange (which can be returned, held until maturity, or discounted for cash). Three conditions for Documentary Collection: (1) business partners know and trust each other, (2) buyer's willingness and ability to pay are certain, (3) country risk in the importing nation is low.
